zh: 我们早到了机场，所以有时间喝杯咖啡。
en: We got to the airport {early}, so we had time for a coffee.

zh: 航班延误了，所以我们很晚才到家。
en: The flight was delayed, so we got home {late}.

zh: 沿着这条路一直往前走，到红绿灯左转。
en: Go {straight} down this road and turn left at the lights.

zh: 你曾经去过南岛吗？
en: Have you {ever} been to the South Island?

zh: 到目前为止，我去过皇后镇三次。
en: I've been to Queenstown three times {so far|already}.

zh: 公交车最后晚了四十分钟才来。
en: The bus {eventually|finally} turned up forty minutes late.

zh: 我们快到了，再有十分钟就好。
en: We're {nearly|almost} there, just ten more minutes.

zh: 我姐姐住在国外，所以我一年只见她一次。
en: My sister lives {overseas|abroad}, so I only see her once a year.

zh: 还好我们赶上了最后一班渡轮。
en: {Luckily|Fortunately|Thankfully}, we caught the last ferry.

zh: 注意安全驾驶，今晚路面结冰了。
en: Drive {safely|carefully}, the roads are icy tonight.

zh: 这趟火车直达机场，不用换乘。
en: This train goes {directly|straight} to the airport, so you don't need to change.

zh: 山顶的景色简直美极了。
en: The view from the top was {absolutely|totally|utterly|simply|truly|really} stunning.

zh: 天气很糟糕，但我们照样玩得很开心。
en: The weather was awful, but we had a great time {anyway|regardless|anyhow}.

zh: 你经常出差吗？
en: Do you travel for work {often|much|a lot|frequently}?

zh: 这条路因为塌方目前封闭了。
en: The road is {currently} closed because of a slip.

zh: 我们的行李两天后才到。
en: Our luggage arrived two days {later|afterwards}.

zh: 我们原本打算住一周，结果三天后就走了。
en: We {originally|initially} planned to stay for a week, but we left after three days.

zh: 就这个价格来说，那家汽车旅馆还算干净。
en: The motel was {reasonably|fairly|pretty|quite} clean, considering the price.

zh: 坐飞机很可能比开车便宜。
en: It'll {probably|likely|most likely} be cheaper to fly than to drive.

zh: 我们先停下来吃午饭吧，之后再去参观博物馆。
en: Let's stop for lunch first. We can visit the museum {afterwards|later|after}.
